summary: Invitation Homes Operating Partnership LP filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for a proposed offering of senior unsecured notes. No terms—aggregate principal, interest rate, maturity, or redemption price—are set. The notes are senior unsecured obligations of the operating partnership, guaranteed by parent Invitation Homes Inc., OP GP LLC, and IH Merger Sub LLC. This is an ordinary debt offering, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other event-driven catalyst. What to watch: final pricing and use of proceeds once terms are determined.
